description: v2.2.8 (pre-release): Amazon AMOLED Dark mode resource pass no longer writes Material attribute names the reandroid resource encoder cannot re-resolve (colorSurface, colorSurfaceContainer*, colorBackgroundFloating) — fixes the 'Unknown attribute name' build failure on mShop 32.19.0.300; writes are android:-framework-only. Mereframe diagnostic crash log now records app versionName/versionCode in the report header; the native-integrity bypass logs when its catch is planted. 2026-11-06 build included the universal Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer/Media3) heuristic and Mint/HT app-scoped entries for Block analytics, Disable video autoplay and Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs, plus Indian-market tracker markers and the HT analysis doc — no APK decompiled; Premium unlocks impossible (server-side). v2.2.7 content included. All unverified on device.
